result.title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
result.summary: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. The resulting accounting decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss, separating planning from fixed-role heuristics. AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 budget-paired counterfactual audit 评估协议：固定公开证据与区域绑定，只扰动剩余观察预算或已声明的任务参数，为每条获取历史计算精确续值，并把期望准确率损失分解为逐步获取损失与终止决策损失，以区分规划能力与固定角色启发式；在四十个配对路由锚点及若干开源模型上实施。
AI.relevance_reason: 其获取与终止两段式损失分解直接对应 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中观察与停止的收益成本核算，可供核查 LVR 里证据筛选、停止决策的因果归因与评价框架，尤其看回答是否真正使用已获取的视觉证据。
